surface_mechanism_description: The growth mechanism involves the suppression of new island or step formation due to the maintenance of 100% surface coverage of III and V compound precursors during each source gas supply. The self-limiting mechanism prevents further growth beyond a monolayer, and the surface reconstruction consisting of a double As layer is avoided due to the self-limiting mechanism of incoming AsH3 molecules.
evidence: The surface reconstruction consisting of a double As layer that enhances the facet growth can be avoided since incoming AsH3 molecules cannot adsorb on the As surface because of a self-limiting mechanism.
